"content" : "# UML class diagram:\nmodel MyExpenses\n\ndataType Date\noperations\n    Date(date : String)\nend\n\nenum PaymentMethod {\n    CREDIT_CARD,\n    CHECK,\n    CASH\n}\n\nenum BillStatus {\n    DRAFT,\n    PENDING,\n    VERIFIED,\n    VALIDATED,\n    REFUSED,\n    REFUNDED\n}\n\nclass Expense\nattributes\n    amount : Real\n    startDate : Date\n    endDate : Date\nend\n\nclass Bill\nattributes\n    amount : Real\n    category : String\n    date : Date\n    paymentMethod : PaymentMethod\n    status : BillStatus\nend\n\nclass Comment\nattributes\n    text : String\nend\n\nclass Currency\nattributes\n    name : String\n    abbreviation : String\nend\n\n\ncomposition ExpenseContainsBills between\n    Expense [1]\n    Bill [*] role bills\nend\n\nassociation ExpenseComment between\n    Expense [1]\n    Comment [*] role comments\nend\n\nassociation BillCurrency between\n    Bill [1..*]\n    Currency [1] role currency\nend\n\nconstraints\ncontext Expense inv positiveAmount:\n    self.amount >= 0\n\ncontext Expense inv expenseSumOfBills:\n    self.amount = self.bills->collect(b : Bill | b.amount)->sum()\n\n# Syntax example of instances creation:\n-- This is a comment example\n\n-- Primitive data types:\n    -- Integer i.e. 1, 2, 3, etc.\n    -- Real i.e. 1.0, 21.89, 322.05556, etc.\n    -- Boolean i.e. true or false\n    -- String i.e. 'Hello World'\n\n-- You can create instances with the following syntax:\n!new <instance type>('<instance name>')\n-- Example:\n!new Client('client1')\n!new Store('store4')\n\n-- You can assign values to Integer\n!client1.balance := 1123.45 -- For Real\n!client1.name := 'John' -- For Strings\n!store4.available := true -- For Boolean\n\n-- You can create associations between instances with the the constructor of Location requires two arguments: x and y of type Real. So it can be used as follows:\n!store4.location := Location(14.0, 289.0)\n\n-- Enums usage:\n    -- enum Type { Clothes, Shoes }\n-- Can be used as follows:\n!store4.type := #Clothes\n\n# Instance description:\nPlease create the instance according to this specification:\n## Baseline Instance: Weekend Getaway Expense\n\n### Expense\n\n- **amount**: 550.00\n- **startDate**: \"2023-01-15\"\n- **endDate**: \"2023-01-17\"\n\n### Bills\n\n1. **Bill 1**: \n   - **amount**: 350.00\n   - **category**: \"Hotel Accommodation\"\n   - **date**: \"2023-01-15\"\n   - **paymentMethod**: CREDIT_CARD\n   - **status**: VERIFIED\n   - **currency**:\n     - **name**: \"United States Dollar\"\n     - **abbreviation**: \"USD\"\n\n2. **Bill 2**:\n   - **amount**: 100.00\n   - **category**: \"Meals\"\n   - **date**: \"2023-01-16\"\n   - **paymentMethod**: CASH\n   - **status**: VALIDATED\n   - **currency**:\n     - **name**: \"United States Dollar\"\n     - **abbreviation**: \"USD\"\n\n3. **Bill 3**:\n   - **amount**: 100.00\n   - **category**: \"Gasoline\"\n   - **date**: \"2023-01-17\"\n   - **paymentMethod**: CHECK\n   - **status**: PENDING\n   - **currency**:\n     - **name**: \"United States Dollar\"\n     - **abbreviation**: \"USD\"\n\n### Comment\n\n- **Comment 1**:\n  - **text**: \"Nice and cozy hotel, worth the price!\"\n\nThis instance covers all aspects of the conceptual model by representing an expense for a weekend getaway, consisting of multiple bills with varied categories, payment methods, and statuses. "content" : "# UML class diagram:\nmodel MyExpenses\n\ndataType Date\noperations\n    Date(date : String)\nend\n\nenum PaymentMethod {\n    CREDIT_CARD,\n    CHECK,\n    CASH\n}\n\nenum BillStatus {\n    DRAFT,\n    PENDING,\n    VERIFIED,\n    VALIDATED,\n    REFUSED,\n    REFUNDED\n}\n\nclass Expense\nattributes\n    amount : Real\n    startDate : Date\n    endDate : Date\nend\n\nclass Bill\nattributes\n    amount : Real\n    category : String\n    date : Date\n    paymentMethod : PaymentMethod\n    status : BillStatus\nend\n\nclass Comment\nattributes\n    text : String\nend\n\nclass Currency\nattributes\n    name : String\n    abbreviation : String\nend\n\n\ncomposition ExpenseContainsBills between\n    Expense [1]\n    Bill [*] role bills\nend\n\nassociation ExpenseComment between\n    Expense [1]\n    Comment [*] role comments\nend\n\nassociation BillCurrency between\n    Bill [1..*]\n    Currency [1] role currency\nend\n\nconstraints\ncontext Expense inv positiveAmount:\n    self.amount >= 0\n\ncontext Expense inv expenseSumOfBills:\n    self.amount = self.bills->collect(b : Bill | b.amount)->sum()\n\n# Syntax example of instances creation:\n-- This is a comment example\n\n-- Primitive data types:\n    -- Integer i.e. 1, 2, 3, etc.\n    -- Real i.e. 1.0, 21.89, 322.05556, etc.\n    -- Boolean i.e. true or false\n    -- String i.e. 'Hello World'\n\n-- You can create instances with the following syntax:\n!new <instance type>('<instance name>')\n-- Example:\n!new Client('client1')\n!new Store('store4')\n\n-- You can assign values to Integer\n!client1.balance := 1123.45 -- For Real\n!client1.name := 'John' -- For Strings\n!store4.available := true -- For Boolean\n\n-- You can create associations between instances with the the constructor of Location requires two arguments: x and y of type Real. So it can be used as follows:\n!store4.location := Location(14.0, 289.0)\n\n-- Enums usage:\n    -- enum Type { Clothes, Shoes }\n-- Can be used as follows:\n!store4.type := #Clothes\n\n# Instance description:\nPlease create the instance according to this specification:\n## Baseline Instance: Weekend Getaway Expense\n\n### Expense\n\n- **amount**: 550.00\n- **startDate**: \"2023-01-15\"\n- **endDate**: \"2023-01-17\"\n\n### Bills\n\n1. **Bill 1**: \n   - **amount**: 350.00\n   - **category**: \"Hotel Accommodation\"\n   - **date**: \"2023-01-15\"\n   - **paymentMethod**: CREDIT_CARD\n   - **status**: VERIFIED\n   - **currency**:\n     - **name**: \"United States Dollar\"\n     - **abbreviation**: \"USD\"\n\n2. **Bill 2**:\n   - **amount**: 100.00\n   - **category**: \"Meals\"\n   - **date**: \"2023-01-16\"\n   - **paymentMethod**: CASH\n   - **status**: VALIDATED\n   - **currency**:\n     - **name**: \"United States Dollar\"\n     - **abbreviation**: \"USD\"\n\n3. **Bill 3**:\n   - **amount**: 100.00\n   - **category**: \"Gasoline\"\n   - **date**: \"2023-01-17\"\n   - **paymentMethod**: CHECK\n   - **status**: PENDING\n   - **currency**:\n     - **name**: \"United States Dollar\"\n     - **abbreviation**: \"USD\"\n\n### Comment\n\n- **Comment 1**:\n  - **text**: \"Nice and cozy hotel, worth the price!\"\n\nThis instance covers all aspects of the conceptual model by representing an expense for a weekend getaway, consisting of multiple bills with varied categories, payment methods, and statuses.
